speaker: john_heminges
text: It has gone four. In this fog the candle is the clock I trust. Come in and be counted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four, by your candle. The torches on the last of Titus were standing in haloes as I came up. I was not in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You were not in it. Thirty-four shillings is the share. I am counting it by this candle, and I am not reading you a coffer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thirty-four. Last Saturday was thirty-five, and the week was no prettier. You have mislaid a shilling and called it arithmetic.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have mislaid nothing. Thirty-five was then. Thirty-four is now. Both are the share. Neither is a balance.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the hired men?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Their ten shillings is their wage. It is not sitting inside your thirty-four, and I am not taking it out a second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then thirty-four is what I carry home. I will not add it to a sum I have not counted.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Next week, while you are still. Monday, Errors. You open, Will. Tuesday, the Two Gentlemen, and you are in it. Wednesday, the king again, and you are in that too.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday I open. I have nothing to say tonight about a first speech. The page at home is not that page.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Keep your first speech. When you have a part with a floor under it, you may tell me. Not before, and not in a fog.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: What did the Rose hang? The fog took the writing off every post I passed.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Wise Man. That is the title I was given. I have no receipt, and I will not invent one because the air is thick.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not. A bill is not a sum. We did not cross.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have no Revels line to read you out of this candle. If a fee is owed, it is not in your share, and it is not in my mouth tonight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thirty-four shillings and a fog. You are a poor host, John, and you know it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am a counter. The candle says it has gone four. The stacks say thirty-four. You may dislike either. You may not change them.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I dislike the fog. I will take the thirty-four. The three nights can wait for their hours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They can wait. Kettleby has the hours. We do not. And I am not promising any man a line before it is on a leaf.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then write your leaf and do not tell me the plot on a Saturday. I have a shilling to mourn, and mourning is hungry work.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The bills I named are set. I have not set you an errand. Go home before the lane goes.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go. I am shutting the book. There is no total in it for any of you tonight.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: No total. Good. I can carry thirty-four without a speech about the year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-four, and home. The candle there is a different candle.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Take it, then. And you, sir, if the week is thirty-four again I shall compose a lament. It will be short, like everything you give me.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Compose it in the lane. The candle is done counting.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Monday you open. That is the last thing on the bill. Good night.
